<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 5:4:4">Y. Maas. Sh. V, 56ᶜ</cite> top <he>גלילא ע׳</he> Upper Galilee; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 11b:2">Snh. 11ᵇ</cite> (not <cite ref="C00947"><he>גלילאה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Sotah 40a:7">Sot. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>יתקלס ע׳</he> the Most High will be praised.

<cite ref="Pesachim 76a:2">Pes. 76ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ע׳ גבר</he>, v. <cite ref="C00129"><he>גְּבַר</he> I</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 58:3">Targ. Ps. LVIII, 3</cite> some ed., v. <cite ref="P00567"><he>עִילָא</he> II</cite>.—
Targ. Y. Gen. II, 22 עלאה, ed. Amst., v. עִלְעָא.]—Pl. עִילָאֵי, עִילָיֵיא, עִלָ׳ Targ. Y. Gen. I, 6 (I ed. Vien. עִלָּ׳).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 104:13">Targ. Ps. CIV, 13</cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="P00569"><he>עִלַאי</he></cite> sing., ref. to <he>בית</he>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 107b:15">B. Mets. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>קוצו ע׳ וכ׳</he> cut down the trees on the upper and on the lower river banks, then I shall cut mine.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 108a:6">Ib. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>תתאי מסייעי ע׳</he> those below must assist those above (in felling the trees).

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:57">Lam. R. to I, 16</cite>; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:19">IV, 19</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 5:1:4">Y. Succ. V, 55ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="A03222"><he>אַרְעָאָה</he></cite>.

Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵈ top דִּלָא שלח ע׳ לא שלח ארעייה for if he does not take off the upper socks, he cannot take off the lower ones (hence they are considered as if sewed together); a. fr.—Fem. עִילִיתָא; pl. עִילְיָיתָא, עִילְיָתָא.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 116b:3">B. Mets. 116ᵇ</cite> <he>עִלְיָיתָא אתבור</he> (Ms. M. <he>עִילְיָתָא איתבר</he>, corr. acc.) the uppermost bricks were broken, v. <cite ref="H00044"><he>חֲבָטָא</he></cite>.
